d:
Invaders attack the world and two scientists who happen to be a couple produce a miraculous device that allows them to fight against them. Tapping into the opposing powers of the invaders they transform into magical girls using cuteness to defeat their enemies. Unfortunately they meet an enemy that they don't expect and fall into their trap...
